read_path_diagnostics.typed_argument_cause: Canonical and diagnostic schema declare get_agent(agent_address: str). The installed official CLI parser maps every 0x-prefixed 40-hex token to CalldataAddress; its scalar parser does not unwrap a standalone JSON-quoted string argument. Thus CLI call cannot represent the declared plain-string address argument faithfully. The call failure is an argument-encoding/client-path failure and is not evidence of a canonical-only contract defect.
